It serves the maintainer's ruling quoted verbatim on the card and in the PR body, 「规则应该写入 objectui 仓库，要不然每个项目都会有页面定制的需求」: the rule itself lands in objectui (draft objectstack-ai/objectui#12253); this line keeps product-specific page demands from reaching that lane as cards. Placement is right: inside the 立卡门 bullet list, after the ⛔ 不是卡 rows and before the POST-前 checklist. One executable sentence, no tracker number in it.
- **Deleted clause: a description, no rule lost — right.** The intro's 「;本文是「什么才算一张卡」与定级、读数三组判据的执行说明」 restates the file's three H2 headings (`## 立卡门`, `## 定级判据(北极星「优先级」的执行说明)`, `## 读数判据(判据的可达半径与零)`), all three of which remain. The pointer sentence 「见 triage-duties.md 与 reading-discipline.md 的指针行。」 stands alone on line 3 with its full stop. This is option A of the dev's open question, as the PM ruled in `6125224340`.
- **Line ratchet: 58 → 58 against a ceiling of 58, headroom 0, ceiling untouched — right.** Measured on the fetched blobs at `main` and at the head: 58 lines each; `diff` shows exactly lines 3–4 collapsing to line 3 and one insertion at line 24, nothing else moved and no re-wrap. The new line is 116 bytes, under the ratchet's 120-byte line cap. The file's table-row pin (0) is unchanged. The freed line comes from deleted content, not from merging lines, which is what the ratchet's discipline asks.
- **PR body: names the card, no closing keyword — right.** `objectstack-ai/objectui#12224` and `objectstack-ai/objectui#12253` appear with no keyword before either; a keyword-plus-reference scan of the body finds no hit. The sentence "It closes no card." contains the verb but no reference, so it binds none of the repo's three registered parsers (all require `#N` or `owner/repo#N`); the `Part-of PR must not also close its card` and `The card this PR closes must claim this branch` check-runs are `success`. Branch, title and body match the claim `6124339842` and the dev report `6125436892`.

The remaining skips are the same paths filter (Build Docs, Console Pin Gate, the Test Core and Dogfood shard matrices, Temporal Conformance, the opt-in tarball smoke) and the `labeled` re-run's no-op legs. Nothing red, nothing pending.

The diff implements exactly that and nothing more. Closed.

All three are bookkeeping, answered, none escalated.

No maintainer approval is owed; the maintainer may still object on the PR, as the body invites.
